C0619.title: Two Individuals Forged 500 Receipts, Used Photo Editing Software to Rack Up Millions of Points for Profit, Shanghai Police: Arrested
C0619.summary: Shanghai police uncovered a case of defrauding a shopping mall of loyalty points by forging receipts. Suspects Zhang and Zhou collected discarded customer receipts and used photo editing software to forge nearly 500 dining receipts, totaling millions of yuan.
